title: The Mirror in the Dark
content:
Mia was alone at home on a dark night.

She heard a strange noise behind her bedroom door.

— Who is there?

There was no answer.

Mia looked under the bed. Nothing.

Then she saw an old mirror on the wall.

Her reflection was standing in front of the mirror.

But Mia wasn't.

She moved closer.

— Why aren't you moving?

The reflection smiled.

Mia stepped away from the mirror.

Suddenly, the reflection raised its hand.

— Stop! — Mia screamed.

The mirror began to shake.

Then the reflection walked out of the mirror.

Mia ran toward the door, but something was standing behind it.

She turned around.

The room was empty.

The mirror was empty too.

Mia slowly looked under the bed again.

Two pale hands were reaching out from the darkness.

— Mia...

She froze.

The voice was coming from inside the mirror.

And then the bedroom door closed by itself.
